description:
When to use: the caller wants duration, or how this portfolio changes when rates move.

    Inputs: portfolio_id from list_portfolios. The caller's token is the owner scope. Do not pass a user id or a symbol list. The route reads the bond funds and rate-sensitive stocks on that portfolio.

    What comes back: the route JSON, unchanged. duration is in years. dv01 is the book-currency change for a 1 basis point rise, and a negative number means the book loses value. value_change is the book-currency change for shock_bp, the parallel rise the route used. lines name each contribution. A portfolio the token does not own is the same not-found answer as a missing id.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID from list_portfolios

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_rate_sensitivity
title: Get portfolio rate sensitivity
